title: How Many Nukes to BEAT Gotham Baby?
summary: Tony's king plus one Nuke (queen + knightrider) vs chess.com's Baby Gotham bot with a full army. Self-imposed extra goal: capture every one of Baby Gotham's pieces before giving checkmate. He snipes the rooks via knight-rider jumps to the back rank, eats everything, then mates with the nuke alone (Nh6-b3 style, ~6:17).
rules: Player: king + 1 Nuke (would add one per loss; not needed). Opponent: full army.
Challenge rule: all of the opponent's pieces (and pawns) must be captured before delivering checkmate (only the king left).
win_condition: Capture every enemy piece, then checkmate (won with 1 nuke).

opponent.name: Baby Gotham (chess.com bot)
opponent.avatar_description: cartoon baby version of GothamChess (Levy Rozman): big head, dark hair, baby outfit (rating not shown in frames; ~800 inferred)

board.theme_notes: blue-grey/white board; nuke legal dots cover most of the board

setup: White: Ke1 + Nuke on d1. Black: full army (rnbqkbnr/pppppppp).
current_impl_issues: Impl starts with 2 nukes; video uses 1 nuke and was enough.
Missing the 'capture everything before mate' goal.
